title: ‘One website for one local body’ implemented, says Keralam Minister K.M. Shaji
description: Dedicated official websites have been readied for 941 grama panchayats, 152 block panchayats, 14 district panchayats, 87 municipalities, and six Municipal Corporations, which will publish local body profile, details of people’s representatives and officials, Budget, development schemes, information, decisions, reports, tenders, citizen services
